changelog: Aura AI v2.4.5 — Dark Vibrant RGB Orb, Native Chat Control & Persistent Memory
Voice Greeting Placement: Greeting title sits comfortably below the floating top header with clean status bar insets
Dark Vibrant RGB Particle Orb: Deep, punchy jewel-toned RGB color cycle (sapphire, emerald, ruby, amethyst) with high particle opacity against white backgrounds
Native In-App Chat Control: Native send_message_to_chat tool dispatches messages directly to current or new chats without accessibility or screen share
Persistent Chat History & Memory: Instant search and recall of previous chats and code projects via list_recent_chats and open_chat_by_id
Clean Task Dispatch: Eliminated stale wrapper prefixes; tasks are dispatched cleanly to newly created chats
Voice Browser Closure: Cleanly close the in-built browser via voice (close_in_app_browser) without triggering system recents
